intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for InMemoryValidatedSampleStream. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing ValidatedSampleStream with Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(properties.validatedStreamCapacity(), false) (autoCancel false so a subscriber disconnect never terminates ingestion). publish emits with emitNext and Sinks.EmitFailureHandler.busyLooping(properties.emitRetryTimeout()); on FAIL_OVERFLOW or FAIL_TERMINATED it returns Mono.error(IllegalStateException). No unbounded buffer, no blocking. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration. Cover: events delivered in order to a subscriber, overflow beyond capacity errors with IllegalStateException, sink survives a subscriber cancel (later publish still works).
